title: 65_HS1-834228961_62-HQ-83894_Serial_438
doc_notes: This document is an FBI case file regarding the 1964 Socorro, New Mexico UAP sighting by Officer Lonnie Zamora, containing multiple redundant copies of the same investigative report and site diagrams.

incidents.summary: Officer Lonnie Zamora observed a shiny, oval-shaped object land in an isolated area southwest of Socorro, New Mexico, accompanied by a loud roar and flame. He reported seeing two figures in white coveralls near the object before it took off, leaving behind physical traces including indentations and burned brush.
incidents.quote: some unknown object which landed and has taken off
